title: The title cards in Blade Runner are amazing
summary: Michael Lopp explores the iconic opening title cards of Blade Runner (1982), analyzing the typography and visual design choices that make them memorable. The article delves into the artistry behind the film's visual identity and its influence on sci-fi aesthetics.
problem_solved: Explores and appreciates the design excellence of classic film title sequences and their lasting impact on visual storytelling.
why_valuable: Provides insight into how thoughtful design choices in film typography contribute to atmosphere and audience immersion in sci-fi cinema.
